# Skills
Skills decide what you can use at all, how well you use it and how fast you work. Each skill has levels: 0 means untrained, and higher is better. A skill you do not have counts as 0.
## Checking Your Skills - [bold]Examine yourself[/bold] and click the cap icon to see your skills and their levels. You can check other people's the same way. - A few things can raise your skills for the round, such as certain pamphlets. - Many timed actions (building, repairing, treating, carrying and so on) get faster at higher levels, and some equipment refuses to work below a certain level.
## Combat - [bold]Firearms[/bold] (levels 0-4): handling guns. Untrained shooters are less accurate and spread their shots more; higher levels steady your aim. - [bold]Smart Gun[/bold] (0-1): using the smartgun at all. - [bold]Specialist Weapons[/bold] (0-2): using the specialist weapon kits. - [bold]Melee Weapons[/bold] (0-3): swinging blades and blunt weapons well. - [bold]CQC[/bold] (0-5): fighting up close, disarming and grappling. - [bold]Endurance[/bold] (0-5): stamina for running and exertion.
## Engineering - [bold]Construction[/bold] (0-5): building barricades, walls and fortifications. Higher levels unlock sturdier builds and build faster. - [bold]Engineer[/bold] (0-4): repairs, wiring, power and hacking. Higher levels work faster. - [bold]Power Loader[/bold] (0-3): driving the power loader to move heavy cargo and dropship ordnance. - [bold]Vehicles[/bold] (0-3): driving and crewing vehicles. - [bold]Domestics[/bold] (0-3): cooking and other day-to-day tasks.
## Medical - [bold]Medical[/bold] (0-5): treating the wounded and using medical gear. At 1 a health scanner shows internal bleeding, fractures and shock risk; at 3 it shows how bad each fracture is. Higher levels treat faster. - [bold]Surgery[/bold] (0-4): performing operations. Higher levels operate faster. - [bold]Research[/bold] (0-3): chemistry and research work.
## Command and Support - [bold]Leadership[/bold] (0-4): command equipment and giving orders. - [bold]Overwatch[/bold] (0-3): using overwatch consoles. - [bold]JTAC[/bold] (0-4): calling in fire support, laser designating and directing mortars. - [bold]Intel[/bold] (0-5): finding and using intelligence. Higher levels gather it faster. - [bold]Police[/bold] (0-4): security equipment and arrests. - [bold]Fireman[/bold] (0-5): carrying people over your shoulder. Higher levels pick people up faster.
## Flight - [bold]Pilot[/bold] (0-3): flying and arming dropships and fighters. - [bold]Navigations[/bold] (0-2): ship navigation consoles. - [bold]Aircrew[/bold] (0-1): keeping your feet on a dropship. - Between landing zones a dropship hits turbulence every so often. Everyone's view shakes, and anyone standing and not buckled in can be thrown around or knocked down. - Dropping out of a warship's bay is worse: a few seconds of freefall, then heavy turbulence. - With this skill you stay standing through all of it. Without it, buckle in before takeoff.
## Tips - If a tool or weapon does not work for you, or is very slow, check your skills. - Leave jobs that need a high skill to people trained for them, and ask for help when you need it.
